theorems.name: Submission.dor_ims_sua_mollify_unit_field
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (V : Set (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n) (ε : ℝ), IsOpen V → Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ V → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (g x) ≤ 1) → 0 < ε → ∃ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, IsTestForm ω ∧ tsupport ω ⊆ V ∧ (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (ω x) ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (ω x - g x) ≤ ε
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
